meaning.en: (slang) To overcome (a bothersome or difficult issue or obstacle); to free onself of (a problem).

meaning.en: Any of various moves in dance in which the leg is extended from the body.

sentences.en: Finding it locked, she began to kick and scream all over again.

sentences.vi: Tôi thích đá quả bóng lớn của mình.

sentences.en: They're not going to kick us out.

sentences.en: We'll kick it up old school.
sentences.vi: Chúng tôi sẽ khởi động nó ở trường cũ.
